title: Warm and Steamed Mexican Yellow Split Peas Wrap
description: A refreshing and nutritious Mexican-inspired dish made with steamed yellow split peas, wrapped in a leafy leaf wrap and served with a spicy kick.
instructions: Rinse the yellow split peas and soak them in water for 4 hours or overnight.
Drain and rinse the soaked yellow split peas, then transfer them to a bamboo steamer basket.
Steam the yellow split peas over boiling water for 20 minutes, or until they are tender.
In a small bowl, mix together chopped onion, chopped cilantro, minced jalapeno, lime juice, coconut oil, salt, and black pepper.
Warm the leaf wraps by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
To assemble the wrap, lay a warmed leaf wrap flat on a bamboo tray and fill it with steamed yellow split peas, followed by the onion-cilantro-jalapeno mixture.
Fold the bottom half of the leaf wrap up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the wrap into a neat cylinder.
